study: R2H 12B — KODEX 200 CUSUM x market dynamics alignment (T22)

market.return_unit: 100 * diff(ln Close), % (returns from 2019-01-03, same as T21 load_market)
market.rolling_sd: pandas rolling(w).std(ddof=1) on the full return series from 2019-01-03, then sliced to 2020-01-02..2025-12-30 (same as featurestore.py)
market.index_base_date: 2019-12-30 (last close before evaluation start); indexed_close = 100 * close / close_base; cumulative_log_return = 100 * ln(close_t / close_base)
market.predicted_vol: sqrt(v_hat) where v_hat > 0 (RAW policy allows v_hat <= 0 -> NA, status NONPOSITIVE_FORECAST); annualized = sqrt(252 * v_hat). Label: conditional forecast of r^2, not a demeaned sample SD

scales.B_ratio: T / h(alpha=0.05) from null_calibration.pkl; page_two: upper_state / h_up and lower_state / h_down separately, never a single scalar; DESCRIPTIVE_CALIBRATION_REFERENCE (N1 null invalid on observed data)
scales.C_percentile_posthoc: rank of T within the same experiment's 2020-2025 valid values (average ranks, in (0,1]); POSTHOC_DESCRIPTIVE

D_past.past_percentile: share of the experiment's own valid values on days t-252..t-1 (strictly before t) that are <= T_t (ties count 1/2)
D_past.past_robust_score: (T_t - median_past) / IQR_past over the same strictly-past window; IQR_past <= 1e-12 -> NA with status DEGENERATE_PAST_SCALE
D_past.insufficient: fewer than 120 valid past values -> NA, status INSUFFICIENT_PAST

level.rule: past-only expanding quantile of the anchor's own values strictly before t (history from 2019, min 252 values)
level.posthoc_variant: same cuts on the full 2020-2025 sample, labelled POSTHOC

change.rule: past-only expanding quantile of d20 (min 252 values): >= q0.80 EXPANDING, <= q0.20 CONTRACTING, else STABLE

regimes.matrix: level (4) x change (3) = 12 cells; HIGH/EXTREME & STABLE = persistent high state, any level & EXPANDING = expansion

events.set_A_t20_intervals: events_11.csv (11 intervals; PILOT 2020, PRIMARY 2021-2025; shock_type 누적형/단일 충격형) — defined independently of CUSUM
events.set_B_vol_onsets: day t where anchor crosses above its past-only expanding q0.90 after >= 20 consecutive days below it (min 252 history)
events.window_exit: for each single-day |r| top-10 day d in 2020-2025: exit date of a w-window = d + w trading days (w in 20, 60, 120, 252)

lead_lag.series: first differences of past_percentile (policy) vs first differences of ln anchor (market); Spearman correlation on days where both valid
lead_lag.sign: positive lag k = policy at t+k vs market at t (policy lags market)
lead_lag.label: DESCRIPTIVE (no inference; serial dependence)

agreement.value: Spearman rho of cusum_raw_T between experiments on common valid days (min 250 common days, else NA)
agreement.missingness: Jaccard similarity of NA patterns, clustered separately
agreement.alarm: Jaccard similarity of alpha=0.05 alarm day sets (descriptive)
agreement.clustering: average-linkage hierarchical on 1 - rho, cut at rho >= 0.9 (redundant) — reported, not optimized

incremental_information.target: ln of 20-day realized SD of returns t+1..t+20 (future, POSTHOC target)
incremental_information.candidate: policy past_percentile (and raw T for the representative set)
incremental_information.evaluation: leave-one-calendar-year-out OLS, folds 2021..2025, 20-day embargo on both sides of the test year; out-of-sample R^2 gain = R2(base+feat) - R2(base) on the test year, common valid days only
variants: all years as training (2020 in training only)
incremental_information.label: DESCRIPTIVE incremental information; overlapping target

x1_real_data.observed: X1_page_up_sn / X1_page_down_sn / X1_page_two_sn from the ledger (B1 residuals, m_hat over [t-252, t-61], min 120 valid) — no refit
x1_real_data.warm_variant: X1w (EXPLORATORY_EXTENSION, 12B): same statistic but the reference window may use the 2019 in-sample standardized residuals of fit 0 (insample_variance, information available at 2020-01-02). Raw state only; no calibrated h; X1 h shown only as a reference line
x1_real_data.label: EXPLORATORY_EXTENSION; observed = NULL_MODEL_INVALID_DESCRIPTIVE

compute: CPU numpy/pandas (no MC, no SVR refit except fit 0 re-fit for X1w in-sample residuals, verified against svr_fits.csv model_hash)
